verseText: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
meaning: The Lord God is the one and only true God. He created the universe. All other gods are worthless. Because they aren't real, they can't do anything.

meaning.question: An idol is something people worship as a god. How is the LORD different from idols?
choices: He is made out of gold

application.prompt: There are many “gods” that people worship in this world. But there is only one God who is real: the Lord God, who made the heavens. What are some other ways you know that the Lord God is real?
